title: Stinger transitions linger on last frame.

labels.name: Confirmed
labels.description: This bug report has been confirmed by project members

body:
### Operating System Info

Ubuntu 22.04

### Other OS

_No response_

### OBS Studio Version

29.1.1

### OBS Studio Version (Other)

_No response_

### OBS Studio Log URL

https://obsproject.com/logs/j8sG5Fkg7phh0vIP

### OBS Studio Crash Log URL

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

The last frame of a stinger transition should be shown for exactly as long as it's supposed to last.

### Current Behavior

The last frame instead lingers for much longer than it should. 
Recording at 60 fps a stinger at 60fps itself lasting for 1 second results in the last frame of the stinger lasting for 15 frames of the resulting video.
For an example :
[stinger used](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/767069216011452450/1112158503130386592/stinger_test.mp4)
[resulting video](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/767069216011452450/1112158502723526656/2023-05-28_01-07-49.mkv)

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Add a stinger transition whose last frame isn't fully transparent
2. Record a scene transition with it
3. Check the recording for lingering frames


### Anything else we should know?

Testing was done on linux here but also has been reproduced [on windows.](https://discord.com/channels/348973006581923840/374636015396192257/1112111833772466247)
As can be expected, this does not reproduce on 29.0.2.
